name: gr.minedo/minedo
title: Minedo
description: Search homes for teachers in Greece near the school of their placement. Read-only, no login.

tools.name: find_school
tools.description: Find a Greek School (σχολική μονάδα) by name or area. Returns its id for search_listings. Use it first when the Teacher names the School of their Placement (τοποθέτηση).

query.description: School name or area, in Greek or English, e.g. "2ο Γυμνάσιο Νάξου" or "Naxos". Όνομα σχολείου ή περιοχή.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search Minedo Listings (homes for the school year) near a School or a point in Greece. Filter by radius, maximum monthly base price, bedrooms, furnished, floor and Cohabitation (συγκατοίκηση). By default it returns only Listings available today; give dates when the Teacher needs the home later. Returns 12 Listings per page with distance and a link to each Listing. distanceKm is the straight-line distance (σε ευθεία γραμμή), not the road distance. Only Listings on the same island as the School or point (or both on the mainland) are returned. Locations are approximate; contact happens on the Listing page. For each Listing, show its title as a link to its url, then the base price, locality, bedrooms and distance. Do not show the url as a separate column or as a bare link. If totalPages > 1, offer the next page. If there are no results, suggest a larger radius or fewer filters.

school_id.description: The School id from find_school. Preferred anchor: the School of the Teacher's Placement.

lat.description: Latitude of a search point. Use with lng when there is no School.

lng.description: Longitude of a search point. Use with lat when there is no School.

max_rent_eur.description: Maximum monthly base price (βασική τιμή) in euro.

furnished.description: fully = επιπλωμένο, partly = μερικώς, no = χωρίς έπιπλα.

cohabitation_allowed.description: true = only Listings that allow Cohabitation (συγκατοίκηση); false = only those that do not. Omit for any.

available_from.description: Start of the period the Teacher needs the home (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit both dates to get only Listings available today. Set it when the Teacher needs the home from a later date, e.g. the school year from 1 September.

available_to.description: End of the period the Teacher needs the home (YYYY-MM-DD).

sort.description: distance (default) = nearest first, cost = cheapest first, newest = most recent first.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get the public details of one Minedo Listing: description, base price and Inclusions, availability, approximate location and a link to its page, where the Teacher contacts the Owner. Inclusions say which costs the base price already covers. contact = reveal: the Teacher sees the phone number on the page; relay: the Teacher leaves their details and the Owner calls back. Never ask the Teacher for personal data in the chat.

listing_id.description: The Listing id returned by search_listings.
